query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='brave/brave-browser' AND number=25716 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON

data.title: Improve Cookie consent blocking in Brave
data.body:
On the wish list to implement, to fix the following consent sites like Google, Youtube, Facebook, Instagram.

Custom snippets for:

- [ ] Google/ Youtube
- [ ] Facebook, Instagram.


Also include some popular snippets to counter checks on cookies/localstorage, improving the effectiveness of the cookie blocking:

- [ ] set-local-storage-item https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L5284
- [ ] set-cookie  https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L4893
- [ ] set-cookie-reload  https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L4935
- [ ] set-session-storage-item https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L5380

data.title: Improve Cookie consent blocking in Brave
Improve Cookie consent blocking in Brave
data.body:
Thanks to Adguard they have snippets used to counter more complex cookie consent messages.

On the wish list to implement, to fix the following consent sites like Google, Youtube, Facebook, Instagram.

Custom snippets for:

- [ ] Google/ Youtube
- [ ] Facebook, Instagram.


Also include some popular snippets to counter checks on cookies/localstorage, improving the effectiveness of the cookie blocking:

- [ ] set-local-storage-item https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L6021
- [ ] set-cookie  https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L5617
- [ ] set-cookie-reload  https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L5673
- [ ] set-session-storage-item https://github.com/AdguardTeam/Scriptlets/blob/master/dist/scriptlets.js#L6081

Examples of these snippets in use https://github.com/AdguardTeam/AdguardFilters/blob/master/AnnoyancesFilter/Cookies/sections/cookies_specific.txt#L9220  (scroll down the file)

uBO Scriplets used by us, https://github.com/brave/uBlock/blob/master/assets/resources/scriptlets.js
